processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The two steel compositions (Fe–8Mn–3Al-0.2C = M1 and Fe–8Mn–3Al–1Si-0.2C = M2) were fabricated using a vacuum arc melting furnace. M2 is the Si-containing alloy whose as-cast condition (M2-AC) is this sample.

processing_steps.method: remelting 4 times by flipping the ingot before each remelt
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The melted ingot was remelted 4 times by flipping the ingot before each remelt to ensure complete and uniform melting of the raw materials throughout the ingot. No further thermo-mechanical treatment was applied to the as-cast state.

structures.overall_structure: As-cast M2 (M2-AC) sample shown by optical micrograph (200 µm scale bar) exhibits a coarse etched grain structure; no phases or phase fractions are quantified for the as-cast condition.

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: coarse etched grain structure (qualitative; no numeric distribution reported)

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Etched with 2 % Nital solution (2 ml Nitric acid + 98 ml Ethanol) for 10–15 s to reveal the microstructure; optical micrograph scale bar 200 µm
characterization_methods.purpose: Microstructural imaging of the as-cast M2 sample (M2-AC)
characterization_methods.key_findings: Coarse etched grain structure observed in the as-cast/homogenised condition M2.

unmapped_findings: The as-cast M2 (M2-AC) sample is the vacuum-arc-melted Fe–8Mn–3Al–1Si–0.2C (M2) ingot after 4× remelting; for this as-cast state the paper reports only an optical micrograph (coarse etched grain structure, Fig. 3, 200 µm scale bar) and no tensile, hardness, or quantitative phase-fraction data — those are reported only for the M2-HR and M2-IA conditions.
The as-cast condition is common to both alloys: Table 1 maps 'As cast' to M1-AC (3Al-0Si) and M2-AC (3Al-1Si); this sample corresponds to M2-AC.
